description: && rejects a non-bool second operand even when the first is false
notes: The spec says logic operators apply only to bools and gives them no short-circuit rule, while the conditional operator section says when errors are suppressed, so a non-bool operand is an error even when the other operand decides the result. hashicorp/hcl converts both operands to bool before its short-circuit check (BinaryOpExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression_ops.go).
reference_error: Unsuitable value for right operand: bool required, but have number
